key_insight: An H²-based equilibrated residual framework provides guaranteed error control and polynomial-degree-robust a posteriori lower bounds for several finite element problems.
engineering_relevance: For solid mechanics, the framework enables guaranteed stress-error assessment in mixed linear elasticity, supporting more reliable simulation verification.
method: Decompose vector- and tensor-valued Sobolev spaces into H² and H¹ components.
Reconstruct symmetric, piecewise-polynomial tensors on vertex patches in broken H(div div) spaces.
Apply residual estimates to conforming FEM for biharmonic, Poisson, and mixed linear elasticity problems.
evidence_signal: Numerical experiments illustrate estimator effectiveness, alongside theoretical guarantees for biharmonic energy error, Poisson L² error, and elasticity stress error.
watch_item: Implementation requires specialized vertex-patch tensor reconstructions; their computational overhead is not quantified in the abstract.
